summary: Across 24 key details Brendan Dassey stated or agreed to, the record shows investigators introduced 8 first, Dassey introduced 11 first, 4 were already public, and 1 may trace to an earlier unrecorded statement. In multiple instances Dassey adopted details only after investigators mentioned them, sometimes by agreeing to leading questions. Four details appeared in public reports before any interview. One detail raised by investigators (a stomach tattoo) was never adopted. The three recorded sessions show heavy interrogator speaking time and repeated use of "we already know," minimization, and demands for truth.
key_points: 8 of 24 key details were first stated by investigators; Dassey adopted several by agreeing to questions (e.g., vehicle in garage, stabbed in stomach, shot in head, blood on garage floor, Avery raised hood, license plates removed, bleach on jeans) — see Mar 1, 2006, Manitowoc County Sheriff's Dept., pp. fassbender, wiegert; Feb 27, 2006, Mishicot High School, p. wiegert.

11 details were first stated by Dassey with no prior mention in transcripts (e.g., tied up with rope, body in RAV4, restrained on bed, hair cut, throat cut, shot with .22 rifle, tires/branches on fire, RAV4 hidden, bedsheets burned, phone/camera/purse burned, bones broken with shovel) — see Feb 27, 2006, Mishicot High School, p. brendan; Mar 1, 2006, Manitowoc County Sheriff's Dept., p. brendan.

4 details were publicly reported before any interview (body burned in fire, license plates removed, vehicle key in bedroom, clothes burned) — see public reports Nov 10–16, 2005; Feb 27, 2006, Mishicot High School, pp. fassbender, wiegert; Mar 1, 2006, Manitowoc County Sheriff's Dept., p. wiegert.
1 detail (bleach on jeans) may trace to an earlier unrecorded statement with Fassbender on the evening of Feb 27, 2006 — see Decision and Order p. 7, citing ECF 19-19 at 10-11.
Investigators raised a stomach tattoo but Dassey never stated or agreed to it — see Mar 1, 2006, Manitowoc County Sheriff's Dept., p. fassbender.

Interrogation tactics across sessions: 52 "we already know" claims, 30 minimization instances, 3 promises, 85 demands for truth; interrogator spoke 68–92% of words per session — see sessions S1, S2, S3.
limits: Audit only identifies the sequence of detail appearance in available transcripts; it cannot assess truthfulness, accuracy, or reliability of any statement.
Does not evaluate whether Dassey’s first-stated details are corroborated by physical evidence or independent witnesses.
Cannot account for information exchanged in unrecorded sessions (S1b, S1c) where additional details may have been suggested or disclosed.
Does not address voluntariness, coercion, or legal admissibility of the statements.
